title: FBI documents tracking Puharich's movements in Israel

tellings.quote: only thing we were able to get was this big chunk of FBI documents which was basically monitoring all of his movements in Israel

plain: In the early 1970s the FBI kept watch on Andrija Puharich, a scientist with intelligence ties who believed he had contacted a council of alien beings, as he moved around Israel. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says on the show that the only thing his requests under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, turned up was "this big chunk of FBI documents which was basically monitoring all of his movements in Israel." If true, it would show the government took Puharich's activities seriously enough to follow him abroad.
